text:
alex_kim: Heads up — kickoff for rollout plan: region-aware model-downgrade (auto-quant-fallback). Need a short canary + A/B + telemetry plan. Goal: reduce token cost & P95 latency under load by switching to quantized model variant when pressure is detected. Draft below, feedback please.

priya_sinha: :eyes: scope? hosted, dedicated, private?

alex_kim: Start hosted + dedicated. Private = manual opt-in for now (regulatory customers want explicit consent).

mateo_rg: How are we protecting output quality? quant variants can change semantics.

li_chen: Proposal: two-phase approach — Phase A: shadow routing (5% sampled requests mirrored to quant model, no user-visible change) to collect quality deltas and KV-cache behavior. Phase B: live A/B with 2% traffic live to quant variant for 48h, metrics check and manual gate before ramp.

sara_ops: Which KPIs do we gate on?

alex_kim: Primary KPIs: P95 latency, request error rate, cost per 1M tokens, and a quality signal. Initial thresholds: require P95 latency improvement >= 10% OR cost save >= 20% to consider ramp. Quality: embedding cosine drop < 0.02 on our eval set OR language metric delta within acceptable bounds. User-reported regressions must be < 0.1% of requests for the window.

mateo_rg: I'll wire the eval harness. Plan to use the canonical prompt set at releases/model_downgrade (~1k queries) plus a 200-human-sample review. Telemetry: tokens/s, GPU mem, kv-cache hit/miss per-session.

priya_sinha: SRE gating checklist: metrics stable for 24h, no production OOMs, error rate not > baseline*1.5, and infra-side OOM <= 1 per 100k requests. Add auto-circuit-breaker: if error rate spikes 2x OR P95 latency > baseline*1.5 for 10m, route traffic back to full model.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: shadow-canary job queued for 2024-10-05T15:00Z — will run snapshot job and attach telemetry.

li_chen: Feature-flag config suggestion in one line for the UI: 
`region_model_downgrade` params: `shadow_pct`, `live_pct`, `latency_threshold_ms`, `similarity_threshold`, `regions_allowed`, `tenant_override`
(we'll store defaults in the flag config and surface per-tenant overrides).

mateo_rg: Runtime notes: need KV-cache compatibility mapping between full and quant variants — if a session has a KV miss on quant, fallback to full for that session to avoid context drift. Also ensure that continuous-batching logic doesn't mix variants in the same batch.

sara_ops: Runbook items: 1) Per-tenant opt-out flag, 2) Logging for audit + KMS hierarchies, 3) Quick rollback steps for CS to toggle per-customer. Add a canned customer-facing note explaining potential minor fidelity differences.

alex_kim: Owners: Alex (PM), Mateo (runtime eng), Priya (SRE/gates), Li (feature flags), Sara (CS/ops). Timeline proposal: shadow 1 week -> A/B 48 hours -> regional staged ramp (EU -> US -> APAC) over 2 weeks, with manual gates between stages.

priya_sinha: Dedicated tenants: we need a capacity-exempt path; some customers pin quantization profiles. Ensure per-tenant override and a policy doc for pinned allocations.

mateo_rg: I'll spike KV-compat shim + telemetry this week and open a PR with smoke tests. Will also add a small harness to compare outputs and compute similarity metrics.

alex_kim: Thanks. Action items: Mateo to PR runtime shim, Li to create the feature flag + defaults, Priya to draft SRE gating checklist, Sara to draft CS opt-out language and playbook. I'll update the RFC with the checklist and schedule a 30m sync Thu. @li_chen can you create the flag and seed defaults after this thread?

li_chen: On it — will create the flag and post the UI link when ready.

alex_kim: Perfect. If no objections by EOD we'll schedule the shadow next week.
